description: Shared password-policy contract. Canonical copy lives in tasklean-be (src/test/resources/password-policy-vectors.json); mirror it into tasklean-fe. For each vector, the password's FIRST failing rule MUST produce message (null = password is acceptable). Backend: PasswordPolicyValidator; frontend: passwordRule (src/lib/validation/rules.ts) + password/policy.ts. If you change the policy, update BOTH implementations and re-run BOTH suites against this file.
